numericPolicy.internal: arbitrary-precision decimal or integer; no IEEE-754 aggregation
numericPolicy.wire: base-10 decimal string for domain values
numericPolicy.display: locale formatting is presentation-only and must not feed sorting or formulas

windowBoundary.end: evaluation timestamp truncated to whole milliseconds
windowBoundary.lateEventPolicy: recompute every affected non-finalized window; never mutate a finalized window without reconciliation
windowBoundary.reorgPolicy: remove orphaned deltas then recompute affected windows from canonical events

metrics.definition: Sum of protocol fees denominated in USD for canonical swaps in the window.
metrics.nullPolicy: null when any required fee amount, token decimals, or price is unavailable; zero only for a fully observed window with no fees
metrics.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN at display boundary; no aggregation rounding
metrics.source: docs/FUNCTION_MATRIX.md POOL-04 plus locally frozen arithmetic semantics

metrics.definition: Sum of one canonical USD notional per swap in the window; never sum both token legs.
metrics.nullPolicy: null when canonical notional cannot be priced; zero only for a fully observed window with no swaps
metrics.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN at display boundary; no aggregation rounding
metrics.source: docs/FUNCTION_MATRIX.md POOL-04 plus locally frozen double-count prevention

metrics.definition: Point-in-time total pool token balances valued in USD at the window end.
metrics.sampling: as-of latest canonical state strictly before window end
metrics.nullPolicy: null when either balance, decimals, or required price is unavailable; never coerce missing TVL to zero
metrics.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN at display boundary; no formula rounding
metrics.source: documented current_pool_value/pool_usd_value fields plus locally frozen as-of semantics

metrics.definition: Count of unique canonical swap transactions in the window.
metrics.formula: count(distinct chainId, transactionHash among normalized swap events)
metrics.nullPolicy: never null for a fully observed window; zero means no swaps
metrics.source: documented transaction_count/tx_count fields plus locally frozen transaction-level counting

metrics.definition: Fully diluted value of the designated non-quote token at the window end.
metrics.nullPolicy: null when designated token, total supply, decimals, or canonical price is unavailable
metrics.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN at display boundary; no formula rounding
metrics.source: documented current_token_fdv_usd/token_fdv_usd fields; source selection remains unresolved

metrics.nullPolicy: always null until GAP-FORMULA-ATVL is resolved and versioned fixture evidence is approved

metrics.definition: Unannualized fee yield for the selected window.
metrics.nullPolicy: null when Fees or TVL is null or TVL <= 0
metrics.rounding: ROUND_HALF_EVEN to 4 percentage decimal places for display only
metrics.source: docs/FUNCTION_MATRIX.md POOL-05 plus locally frozen unannualized ratio semantics

metrics.definition: Fees divided by aTVL only after the aTVL algorithm is approved.
metrics.nullPolicy: always null while aTVL or its formula is unresolved; null when aTVL <= 0 after resolution
metrics.source: docs/FUNCTION_MATRIX.md POOL-05; exact target formula has insufficient evidence

roundingPolicy.currencyDisplay: 2 decimals below USD 1000; compact suffix may be shown but raw value remains available
roundingPolicy.tokenDisplay: up to token decimals with UI-specific cap; never round persisted values

sorting.direction: explicit asc or desc; default desc for Fees and Volume
sorting.stability: same input snapshot and contract version must produce identical ordering
